title: Backup block in doctor, the `next` reminder, readiness isolation, and the status docs
outcome: Backup block in doctor, the `next` reminder, readiness isolation, and the status docs
acceptance: This changeset adds no backup-dependent field, health value or admission change to `engram readiness --json`, and a test asserts readiness output is the same with and without a configured target; docs/shipped.md and docs/features/cli-and-mcp.md describe the status word, the doctor block and the reminder

`engram doctor` prints the same backup block as `backup status` in text and JSON from the recorded evidence, apart from store health, and contacts no target: a test with an adapter that fails every request shows doctor's backup block and exit unchanged, and a test shows a stale or missing backup leaves a healthy store's `healthy` value true

`next` and `next --peek` add one reminder line when a target is configured and the mode is `local`, or when the last attempt failed, and add nothing when no target is configured or all is well; they read only the recorded state; tests cover the four cases and that a failed last attempt shows while an earlier copy still qualifies; the line is never shed by the output budget, and a test shows that a project with no target configured gets no backup line at all

completion.summary: `engram doctor` prints the backup status block in text and JSON on every path, apart from health and without contacting a target, and says "backup: not read" for a store outside the home layout. `next` and `next --peek` add one protected backup reminder line when a configured target is local or its last push failed, reading only recorded state. readiness is unchanged with or without a target. The docs are updated. Landed 02c031d; installed build bbbaf6c8….
